description: MAIN-PARA's DFHPF3 back-navigation arm taken with a BLANK ORIGIN - the 'COMEN01C' fallback at app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:129-130 - derived from :123-135 with :273-284 and :306-314 reached from it. This is the REENTER half of gate G38, contrasting with case01's ENTER half, and it is the second of the three XCTL shapes this program has: case02 covers the hard-coded 'COSGN00C' of the no-commarea guard at :107-109, this case covers the conditional main-menu fallback of the PF3 arm, and neither transmits a screen, which is why both leave the mapset and the map unnamed. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 SET ERR-FLG-OFF and USR-MODIFIED-NO; :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO; :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero - 218 - so the cold-start arm is not taken; :111 copies the travelled area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; :112 finds NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER false, because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1 and the 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:31 is therefore true, so control takes the ELSE at :123; :124 performs RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN; :125 evaluates EIBAID; :128 matches WHEN DFHPF3; :129 tests CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM against SPACES OR LOW-VALUES and finds it blank, so :130 moves 'COMEN01C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and the ELSE at :131-133 is not taken; :135 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, whose :275-277 guard is a NO-OP here because :130 has already named a target, and whose :278, :279 and :280 then move 'CB00' to CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, 'COBIL00C' to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM and ZEROS to CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT before the single EXEC CICS XCTL at :281-284. The EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID at :146-149 is NOT reached - an XCTL transfers control and never returns - which is why the termination is XCTL and not RETURN_TRANSID. THE ORDERED DISPATCH (gate G30). The EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-142 has exactly four arms and they are, in this source order: DFHENTER performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :126-127; DFHPF3 navigates back at :128-135; DFHPF4 clears the screen at :136-137; and WHEN OTHER at :138-141 sets WS-ERR-FLG, moves CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY and sends. The first match wins and WHEN OTHER is LAST, so DFHPF3 is reached here only because DFHENTER did not match first - had the order been inverted this same request would have paid a bill instead of leaving the screen. There is no PF7, PF8, PF12, CLEAR or PA1 arm in this program and none is invented; app/bms/COBIL00.bms:135 advertises exactly the three named keys with INITIAL='ENTER=Continue  F3=Back  F4=Clear'. DFHAID is IBM-supplied and ABSENT from this repository (AAP risk R-D), so the mnemonic resolves through common.CicsAid, which reproduces DFHPF3 as the EBCDIC digit three, 0xF3. COBIL00C tests EIBAID INLINE, because it copies NEITHER CSSTRPFY NOR CSSETATY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - so common.PfKeyResolver.isPf3 stands in only for that identical byte equality, and none of CSSTRPFY's PF13-PF24 folding is asserted for a program that does not perform it. WHAT THE RECEIVE DOES AND DOES NOT DO. :124 runs on EVERY re-entry, before the AID is examined, and :308-314 is EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COBIL0A') MAPSET('COBIL00') INTO(COBIL0AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD). WS-RESP-CD and WS-REAS-CD are declared at :46-47, named on this command, and then TESTED BY NOTHING on any path - unlike the five file paragraphs from :343 onwards, every one of which evaluates them. That absence is preserved rather than repaired: no RESP branch is invented for it, forcedOutcomes declares none, and this case therefore asserts no error path the COBOL has no code for. Because this arm sends no map, the ten xxxI items the receive filled sit on no compared channel, so mapFields declares none rather than declaring values this path cannot observe. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN. This arm performs no SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :319-338 never runs: no TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO or CURTIMEO is set, sends is empty rather than carrying a screen, and nextMapset and nextMap are absent because naming COBIL00 and COBIL0A here would tell a stateless client to paint the bill-payment screen it has just left. No MOVE -1 TO xxxL runs on this arm, so no cursor is positioned and cursorField is absent. No dataset is touched - PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is the only caller of READ-ACCTDAT-FILE (:177, :184), READ-CXACAIX-FILE (:211), WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE (:233) and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE (:235), and it is not performed - so inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are all empty BY DERIVATION rather than by omission, and the empty expectedWrites is the positive assertion that F3 abandons the conversation without posting anything. expectedMessages is empty: the program has no DISPLAY on this path and it sends no screen, so no line reaches any channel. THERE IS NO MONETARY FIELD ON THIS PATH - the program's single COMPUTE, ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT at :234, is inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY - so no BigDecimal, no scale and no RoundingMode is asserted here, which is stated rather than left as a silent absence. Nor is there a highlight to assert: COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 572 lines, so no red-plus-asterisk expectation exists. The program contains no GO TO and no CALL 'CEE3ABD', and this screen paginates nothing, so nothing is asserted for those either. THE COMMAREA, FIELD BY FIELD (gates G37 and G40, AAP rule R6). EIBCALEN is 218 - the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares (FROM-TRANID X(04) + FROM-PROGRAM X(08) + TO-TRANID X(04) + TO-PROGRAM X(08) + USER-ID X(08) + USER-TYPE X(01) + PGM-CONTEXT 9(01) = 34, plus CUST-ID 9(09) + three X(25) names = 84, plus ACCT-ID 9(11) + ACCT-STATUS X(01) = 12, plus CARD-NUM 9(16) = 16, plus LAST-MAP X(7) + LAST-MAPSET X(7) = 14) plus the 58 bytes of the CDEMO-CB00-INFO group COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends in place inside the same 01 (TRNID-FIRST 16, TRNID-LAST 16, PAGE-NUM 8, NEXT-PAGE-FLG 1, TRN-SEL-FLG 1, TRN-SELECTED 16). That extension stays a SEPARATE member and is never folded into the sixteen shared carriers; this arm reads and writes none of it. Every width above is taken mechanically from the copybook rather than from prose. Of the sixteen shared carriers this arm writes exactly four - CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM at :130, CDEMO-FROM-TRANID at :278, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM at :279 and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :280. The other twelve - CDEMO-TO-TRANID, CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, CDEMO-CUST-MNAME, CDEMO-CUST-LNAME, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET - are untouched and travel back at their INBOUND values, which are spaces at the declared width for every X span and zeros at the declared width for every 9 span; all twelve are declared here at those values explicitly rather than silently zeroed or quietly omitted. All sixteen travel in the payload and none is held anywhere else: no server-side forward, no HTTP redirect, no request dispatch and no session affinity, so there is no server-side session state to keep. THE DISCRIMINATOR. This case and case05 differ in ONE input only, so the pair proves both sides of the :129 IF rather than duplicating one side. Here CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM arrives as EIGHT SPACES - SPACES rather than LOW-VALUES, chosen because :129 tests both and spaces is what a caller that never set the field actually carries - and it is declared explicitly on the request for exactly that reason: left undeclared, the fallback could be read as a harness default rather than as the reason 'COMEN01C' was chosen. The proof is in nextProgram, because 'COMEN01C' can only have come from :130 - :132-133 would have echoed the origin instead. Note that CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM leaves as 'COBIL00C' whatever it arrived as, since :279 overwrites it unconditionally, so the OUTBOUND value is not the discriminator and the inbound declaration is what carries the distinction. DETERMINISM (practice B7). The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant this program's version footer carries at :571 and the same instant every other case in this directory pins. It is UNUSED on this path: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO never runs, and GET-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP at :249-266, whose EXEC CICS ASKTIME sits at :251-253, is reached only from :230 inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, so no compared image depends on it. It is pinned all the same, so that a translation which wrongly painted a header here would produce a checkable value rather than a wall-clock one, and so that nothing in this directory is ever a captured now. US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default, which for a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND. CONTROLLER_POJO, and it has to be. The arm this case pins is MAIN-PARA's, and the migration puts MAIN-PARA in BillPaymentController.payBill: the EVALUATE EIBAID, the :129 test, the :130 fallback and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN are all the controller's, while BillPaymentService owns PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154, CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN at :552-555 and the invalid-key arm, and it records in terms that the DFHPF3 arm's transfer of control is navigation and is the controller's. A SERVICE-kind declaration could therefore never reach :123-135 and could never diff to zero. CONTROLLER_POJO is also the kind ParityCase requires a screenRequest and an expectedResponse for, which is exactly what this case is made of, and it means the handler constructed through its own constructor and called as a plain Java object: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. PROVENANCE. Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:123-135, :273-284 and :306-314 and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and the key legend of app/bms/COBIL00.bms, and the CB00-to-COBIL00C binding at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:337-338 - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it, because such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository (AAP 0.7.6 documents eight verified blockers; 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for explicit confirmation rather than absorbed).
